findings.evidence: The dbff837f digest reports "removed units (218, showing 40)"; the remaining 178 units are not individually available for review.
findings.fix: Provide the complete previous-version digest so every removed unit can be checked against the current files and docs/audit/recovery/session-handoff/record.md.

findings.evidence: The resume-chain assertion requires "python3 scripts/list_handoffs.py" and "python3 scripts/check_staleness.py <handoff-file>", although SKILL.md instructs agents to execute scripts through "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/" from the project root.
findings.fix: Accept commands using the resolved skill directory and check that they run from the project root, rather than requiring bare paths that may not exist there.

findings.evidence: When project paths differ, the workflow says to run a baseline comparison and "then continue with step 3" without checking that the baseline exists and is an ancestor in the current checkout or assigning a staleness level for step 4.
findings.fix: For a different checkout, verify the baseline commit and ancestry in the current checkout before comparing; on missing or diverged history apply the corresponding UNKNOWN recovery, and otherwise explicitly assess staleness and run the resume checklist when it is not demonstrably FRESH.
